title: The Three Fishermen
desc: A father takes his young son fishing on the latter's birthday. When the boy loses his very first fish, which he caught after much deliberation, the father is angered.

title: The Ballad Of The Homeless
desc: A poetic and surreal journey into the lands devastated by the earthquake in Emilia Romagna in 2012, through the eyes of a child and his friends, a snail.

title: The Night Light Monster
desc: A young girl is haunted by the dark in her bedroom and is pulled into an imaginary world. Later, she unexpectedly awakens the night-light monster, who helps her overcome her fears.

desc: Edgar sees bad luck as something for others: if someone experiences it, it is just his or her own fault. Fate sends him on an odd journey of reformation.

title: Pop

desc: An addict has plans to leave town with her girlfriend to live a healthier life, but the reality of her addiction affects everything and everyone around her when she thinks she can have one last high.

title: Ayesha
desc: Ayesha, an independent gay woman struggling to lead a normal life in a homophobic society, takes a stand for herself against her own regressive brother.

title: Tears Of Rain
desc: The filmmaker gives an insight into the severity of the water crisis that the world is facing while also giving a glimpse of a world without water.

title: The Reef
desc: A breathtaking documentary. Underwater filmmaker Tom Park takes us on a visually stunning journey beneath the waves as he explores the Great Barrier Reef.

title: Way of Life
desc: Follows the story of João de Macedo, an underdog big wave surfer who tries to run the world tour without a major sponsor.

title: Mapu Kutran
desc: A visually stunning documentary. Inspired by the Mapuche concept of a disease derived from disrespecting holy sites, this film explores our destructive relationship with nature.

title: Kokoly

title: Two Cars, One Night

desc: A deceased soldier collects shadows of dying men and women to buy himself a second chance at life.

title: Dame
desc: Elizabeth Taylor returns to set after the death of her husband but remains grief stricken and emotionally fragile.

title: Dusk
desc: A young Nepalese sex worker in the red-light district of Kolkata heads out with her intimate client to watch the sunset over the river.

title: Crumpled
desc: Unable to eloquently or accurately represent his thoughts on paper, Anand, the writer, crumples numerous sheets of paper.

title: Parampara
desc: A poor man decides to leave his traditional occupation in order to earn a better living and fulfil his children's desire to receive proper education.

desc: A paranoiac and extravagant Salvador Dalí asks innocent Sigmund Freud for help to be able to inject madness to his art.
